description: CR 702.16j / 702.16e combat damage to the protected player is prevented, and the same attacker otherwise connects
note: The Stasis Coffin's {2}, {T}, exile-itself ability resolves on alice's turn, so on bob's turn the Coffin is in exile and the shield's quality can only come off the stored row. Combat damage rather than a burn spell, since CR 702.16b keeps a protected player from ever being targeted and a burn case would stay green with CR 702.16e's prevention deleted. Two twins differ in one thing each: carol attacked on the same board, and alice attacked with the ability never activated.
